cluster_name.description: The name of the Ceph cluster (e.g., 'ceph', 'mycluster'). Must match the cluster deployed in the environment.

keyring_path.description: Path to the keyring file used by rbd-mirror for authentication to the Ceph cluster. Typically generated via 'ceph auth get-or-create'.

log_to_syslog.description: Enable or disable logging to the system syslog daemon.

log_file_path.description: Path to the general Ceph log file. Leave empty to disable file logging (syslog or stderr only).

log_level.description: Global log level for Ceph daemons (integer 0-20). 0=fatal, 1=error, 5=warning, 10=info, 20=debug.

log_to_stderr.description: If true, send logs to standard error in addition to file or syslog.

daemon_log_file_path.description: Path for rbd-mirror daemon logs. '$name' is replaced with the instance name in multi-instance setups.

items.description: Monitor host (IP:port) to connect to. Leave empty to rely on DNS SRV records or /etc/hosts.

mon_hosts.description: Optional list of Ceph monitors. Useful when DNS SRV is unavailable or for explicit bootstrapping.

worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads used by rbd-mirror to process mirroring tasks. Adjust based on CPU and I/O capacity.

max_concurrent_image_syncs.description: Maximum number of RBD images to sync in parallel per daemon instance. Higher values increase throughput but also I/O load.

concurrent_mirroring_ops.description: Maximum number of concurrent mirroring operations (e.g., snapshot replication, journal reads/writes) to peer clusters.

client_mount_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for client mount operations (e.g., connecting to monitors).

rados_osd_op_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for RADOS OSD operations before failing.

rados_mon_op_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for RADOS monitor operations before failing.

fast_diff_enabled.description: Enable fast-diff (uses object map) to speed up image diff calculations during sync status queries.

journal_compression_enabled.description: Enable compression for journal writes. Requires Ceph Quincy+ and careful testing due to CPU overhead.

auto_resync_on_failure.description: Automatically reinitiate full sync if incremental sync fails. Disable only if full syncs are too expensive.

delete_on_remote_snapshots_deleted.description: When true, delete the mirrored image on the remote cluster if the local image is deleted (including all its snapshots).

image_sync_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between sync status updates and health checks for an image.

journal_max_objects.description: Maximum number of journal objects (0 = unlimited). Controls memory usage in high-throughput environments.

journal_max_entries.description: Maximum number of journal entries per object (0 = default). Useful for tuning journal size in high-latency links.

name.description: Unique name for this rbd-mirror daemon instance.

hostname.description: Optional hostname override. If empty, system hostname is used.

priority.description: Instance priority for leader election. Higher values have precedence in multi-instance setups.

enabled.description: Whether this instance should run. Set to false to disable without deleting config.

items.description: Specific pool names to mirror (optional). If omitted, uses pool_pattern instead.

pools.description: List of pool names to mirror. Mutually exclusive with pool_pattern when present.

pool_pattern.description: Shell glob or regex pattern matching pools to mirror (e.g., 'rbd*', 'backup_*'). Applied only if pools is empty.

recovery_enabled.description: Enable automatic recovery if mirror replay fails (e.g., network interruption).

replay_max_delay.description: Maximum replay delay (seconds) before pausing sync. 0 = no limit. Helps avoid overwhelming remote cluster.

pool_config_overrides.description: Pool-specific configuration overrides (keyed by pool name). Each override sets rbd_mirror_pool_config_<pool>_<key> = <value>.

enabled.description: Enable TLS for inter-cluster peer communication (e.g., for remote mirroring over untrusted networks).

cert_file.description: Path to TLS certificate file for this instance (PEM format). Required if TLS enabled.

key_file.description: Path to TLS private key file (PEM format). Required if TLS enabled.

ca_dir.description: Directory containing trusted CA certificates for TLS verification.

instances.description: List of rbd-mirror daemon instances for multi-instance deployments. Typically one instance per node, but may be increased for HA or sharding.
